                [32m'### 3. Backend Query (`getProductsWithFilters`)\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Declare and implement a Wasp query named `getProductsWithFilters` that reads from the `Product` entity.\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Input arguments object**:\n'[39m +
                [32m'  ```typescript\n'[39m +
                [32m'  {\n'[39m +
                [32m'    search?: string;     // Full-text search term across name and description\n'[39m +
                [32m'    category?: string;   // Exact category match\n'[39m +
                [32m'    brand?: string;      // Exact brand match\n'[39m +
                [32m'    minPrice?: number;   // Minimum price (inclusive)\n'[39m +
                [32m'    maxPrice?: number;   // Maximum price (inclusive)\n'[39m +
                [32m'    inStock?: boolean;   // If true, only return products where inStock is true\n'[39m +
                [32m"    sortBy?: 'price_asc' | 'price_desc' | 'rating_desc' | 'createdAt_desc';\n"[39m +
                [32m'    limit?: number;      // Number of items to return (default 10)\n'[39m +
                [32m'    cursor?: number;     // Product ID cursor for pagination\n'[39m +
                [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                [32m'  ```\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Output object**:\n'[39m +
                [32m'  ```typescript\n'[39m +
                [32m'  {\n'[39m +
                [32m'    products: Product[];\n'[39m +
                [32m'    nextCursor: number | null;\n'[39m +
                [32m'    facets: {\n'[39m +
                [32m'      categories: { name: string; count: number }[];\n'[39m +
                [32m'      brands: { name: string; count: number }[];\n'[39m +
                [32m'    };\n'[39m +
                [32m'  }\n'[39m +
                [32m'  ```\n'[39m +
                [32m"* **Full-Text Search Logic**: Search must perform PostgreSQL full-text search across `name` and `description` using Prisma's `search` modifier (e.g. `name: { search: searchQuery }`), or fallback gracefully if search is empty or invalid.\n"[39m +
                [32m'* **Facet Counts Logic**: The `facets` counts must dynamically reflect the counts of products matching the *current search query and all active filters* (category, brand, price, stock). For example, if a user filters by `inStock: true` and searches for `chair`, the category and brand facet counts must only count products that match both criteria (which would exclude Product 3 since it is out of stock).\n'[39m +
                [32m"* **Pagination**: Implement cursor-based pagination using the product `id`. Return the `nextCursor` representing the last product's ID on the current page if there are more products, or `null` if there are no more products.\n"[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'### 4. Frontend UI\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'Create a clean, responsive frontend page in React (`src/MainPage.tsx`) that uses the `getProductsWithFilters` query. The UI elements must use the following `data-testid` attributes to allow deterministic testing:\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Search input**: `data-testid="search-input"` (input element)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Category filter**: `data-testid="category-filter"` (select element with options for categories, plus an "All" option)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Brand filter**: `data-testid="brand-filter"` (select element with options for brands, plus an "All" option)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Min Price input**: `data-testid="min-price-input"` (input element)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Max Price input**: `data-testid="max-price-input"` (input element)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **In Stock checkbox**: `data-testid="instock-checkbox"` (checkbox input)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Sort select**: `data-testid="sort-select"` (select element with options: `price_asc`, `price_desc`, `rating_desc`, `createdAt_desc`)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Product list**: `data-testid="product-list"` (container element for the products)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Product item**: `data-testid="product-item"` (for each product element, must have a `data-product-id` attribute containing the product\'s ID)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Product name**: `data-testid="product-name"` (within each product item)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Product price**: `data-testid="product-price"` (within each product item, displaying the price)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Product rating**: `data-testid="product-rating"` (within each product item, displaying the rating)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Product category**: `data-testid="product-category"` (within each product item)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Product brand**: `data-testid="product-brand"` (within each product item)\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Facet categories container**: `data-testid="facet-categories"` containing elements with `data-testid="facet-category-item"` and `data-category-name` attribute (e.g. `data-category-name="Electronics"`) showing the category name and its count.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Facet brands container**: `data-testid="facet-brands"` containing elements with `data-testid="facet-brand-item"` and `data-brand-name` attribute (e.g. `data-brand-name="VoltCharge"`) showing the brand name and its count.\n'[39m +
                [32m'* **Load More button**: `data-testid="load-more-button"` (button to load the next page of results using cursor pagination; should only be visible/enabled if `nextCursor` is not null).\n'[39m +
                [32m'\n'[39m +

                    [32m" * api('GET', '/bar/baz', barBaz, { entities: ['Task'], auth: false })\n"[39m +

                    [32m' * {@include ./referenceImports.md}\n'[39m +

                    [32m'type ApiConfig = Omit<Api, "kind" | "method" | "path" | "fn">;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Creates an {@link ApiNamespace} definition.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Applies a shared middleware function to every {@link api} mounted under a\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * given path prefix. Useful for tweaking middleware (e.g. raw body parsing,\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * CORS) for a group of related endpoints.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * See the\n'[39m +

                    [32m'type ApiNamespaceConfig = Omit<ApiNamespace, "kind" | "path">;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Creates a {@link Job} definition.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Jobs are background tasks that persist across server restarts, can be\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * retried on failure, delayed, and scheduled with cron. Pass the worker\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * function as the first argument and configure the executor and schedule\n'[39m +

                    [32m'export declare function job(fn: Job["fn"], config: JobConfig): Job;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @inline\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @expandType Job\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'type JobConfig = Omit<Job, "kind" | "fn">;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Creates a {@link Crud} definition.\n'[39m +

                    [32m'export declare function crud(name: Crud["name"], entity: Crud["entity"], operations: Crud["operations"]): Crud;\n'[39m +

                    [32m'    webSocket?: WebSocket;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * The specification ({@link Spec}) of the app.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Build entries with the dedicated constructors ({@link page}, {@link route},\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * {@link query}, {@link action}, {@link api}, {@link apiNamespace},\n'[39m +

                    [32m'    spec: Spec;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Wasp compiler metadata used by the app.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export interface Wasp {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * The Wasp version this app is built for, as an npm-compatible\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * [SemVer range](https://github.com/npm/node-semver#ranges)\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * (e.g. `"^0.24.0"`).\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    version: string;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Authentication configuration and lifecycle hooks.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * See the [Auth overview](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/overview) for the\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * supported auth methods and how the `User` entity is connected to auth.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * If hooks are async, Wasp awaits them. All hooks receive `prisma` and `req`\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * in their input. Hook return values are ignored except for\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * {@link AuthHooks.onBeforeOAuthRedirect}, which can change the redirect URL.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +

                    [32m' * type from `wasp/server/auth` (e.g. `OnBeforeSignupHook`). See\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * [Auth Hooks](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/auth-hooks) for the full hook\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * inputs and examples.\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * @example\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```ts\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * import { app } from "@wasp.sh/spec"\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * export default app({\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   // ...\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *   auth: {\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     userEntity: "User",\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *     methods: {\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *       usernameAndPassword: {}, // use this or email, not both\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *       google: {},\n'[39m +
                    [32m' *       gitHub: {},\n'[39m +

                    [32m' * })\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * ```\n'[39m +
                    [32m' */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'export interface Auth extends AuthHooks {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Name of the Prisma model that represents the application user connected to\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * your business logic.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * The user entity needs to have an ID field that uniquely identifies each\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * user. It can be of any name and type, but it needs to be marked with `@id`:\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ```prisma title="schema.prisma"\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * model User {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *   id Int @id @default(autoincrement())\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * }\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ```\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * You can add any other fields you want to the user entity. Make sure to also\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * define them in the `userSignupFields` field if they need to be set during\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * the sign-up process.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * See [Accessing User Data](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/entities) for how the\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * user entity connects to the rest of the auth system.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    userEntity: EntityName;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Enabled authentication methods. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    methods: AuthMethods;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Route that Wasp redirects unauthenticated users to when they try to\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * access a page that has `authRequired: true`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * See [Adding Auth to the Project](https://wasp.sh/docs/tutorial/auth#adding-auth-to-the-project)\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * for an example.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAuthFailedRedirectTo: string;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Route that Wasp redirects users to after a successful login or signup.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m"     * Only takes effect when using Wasp's built-in Auth UI.\n"[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * See [Auth UI](https://wasp.sh/docs/auth/ui).\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @default "/"\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAuthSucceededRedirectTo?: string;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'interface AuthHooks {\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called before the user is created. Receives `providerId` plus the common\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * hook input. Throw from this hook to reject a signup based on custom\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * criteria.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onBeforeSignup?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called after the user is created. Receives `providerId`, the created\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * `user`, and, for social auth, `oauth` fields including tokens and the\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * unique OAuth request ID.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAfterSignup?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /** Called once, after the user verifies their email. Receives `email` and `user`. */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAfterEmailVerified?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called before redirecting the user to the OAuth provider. Receives the\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * generated `url` and `oauth.uniqueRequestId`. Return `{ url }` to override\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * the redirect URL.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onBeforeOAuthRedirect?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called before the user is logged in. Receives `providerId` and `user`.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Throw from this hook to reject a login based on custom criteria.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onBeforeLogin?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    /**\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * Called after a successful login. Receives `providerId`, `user`, and, for\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * social auth, `oauth` fields including tokens and the unique OAuth request\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * ID.\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     *\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     * @category Hooks\n'[39m +
                    [32m'     */\n'[39m +
                    [32m'    onAfterLogin?: Reference<AnyFunction>;\n'[39m +
                    [32m'}\n'[39m +
                    [32m'/**\n'[39m +
                    [32m' * Enabled authentication methods for the app.\n'[39m +

                  [32m'            ],\n'[39m +
                  [32m'          };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        }\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      } else {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        // Fallback to contains\n'[39m +

                  [32m'      cursor: cursor ? { id: cursor } : undefined,\n'[39m +

                  [32m'      nextCursor = resultProducts[resultProducts.length - 1].id;\n'[39m +

                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    // Dynamic Facets\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const categoryGroups = await context.entities.Product.groupBy({\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      by: ['category'],\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      where: whereClause,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      _count: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        category: true,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const brandGroups = await context.entities.Product.groupBy({\n'[39m +
                  [32m"      by: ['brand'],\n"[39m +
                  [32m'      where: whereClause,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      _count: {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'        brand: true,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    });\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const categories = categoryGroups.map((g: any) => ({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      name: g.category,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      count: g._count.category,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }));\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    const brands = brandGroups.map((g: any) => ({\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      name: g.brand,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      count: g._count.brand,\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    }));\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    return {\n'[39m +
                  [32m'      products: resultProducts,\n'[39m +

                  [32m'      },\n'[39m +
                  [32m'    };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'  };\n'[39m +
                  [32m'\n'[39m +

            [32m'\n'[39m +
            [32m'# Committing changes with git\n'[39m +

            [32m'- NEVER update the git config\n'[39m +

Instead, after hook failure, fix the issue, re-stage, and create a NEW commit\n'[39m +
            [32m'- When staging files, prefer adding specific files by name rather than using "git add -A" or "git add .", which can accidentally include sensitive files (.env, credentials) or large binaries\n'[39m +
